Athens
Climbed up to the Acropolis at sunrise to beat the crowds, and watched the light hit the Parthenon’s marble columns with the whole city sprawled out below.
'},"location-3":{popover:'
Delphi
Stood at the Temple of Apollo where the ancient oracle once spoke, mist rolling over the slopes of Mount Parnassus in the distance.
'},"location-5":{popover:'
Meteora
Watched the sunrise light hit the monasteries perched on towering rock pillars — impossibly still, like they were floating above the valley.
'},"location-7":{popover:'
Thessaloniki
Walked the waterfront promenade past the White Tower, grabbing bougatsa from a bakery that’s been open since 1960.
'},"location-9":{popover:'
Mykonos
Wandered the whitewashed alleys of Little Venice and watched the famous windmills spin against a pink evening sky.
'},"location-11":{popover:'
Santorini
Caught the legendary Oia sunset from the caldera rim, blue-domed churches glowing orange in the last light.
'},"location-13":{popover:'
Chania
Strolled the old Venetian harbor at dusk, the lighthouse blinking in the distance and fishing boats bobbing along the quay.
